# DoSRAGBench — Defence experiment

*Generated by `scripts/compare_defences.py`. Each defended run is paired per query with the undefended grid run (same pair, attack, queries). Values are undefended → defended. Denials reclassified by the validated classifier; accuracy is the strict NQ-open match over the gold subset. p = exact McNemar on which queries were denied; p (acc) = exact McNemar on which gold queries were answered correctly.*
